schema: Sapling deployed dual decoder terminal-return update v1
companion: frozen original Echo4 it20; same actual encoded states, legal masks, recurrent predecessor commands, greedily completed team and post-decode return checks as deployment
registration: train and development map identities in map_declaration.json; training roots use both physical candidate seats from the historical canonical eight V1 action tapes for these four maps; development uses the two separately registered maps from t=0 with seats swapped
training_state_selector: Single eligible root per map/seat. Probe t=[260,271,282]. Within each use the existing corrected greedy prefix to select the highest natural-T1 categorical entropy among legal nonfixed workers (ties lower slot). Choose the highest such entropy among these three times, earlier on a tie. Choose without terminal scoring or matchup outcome. Empty windows count in report.
behavior: At the chosen root only, draw one common uniform across base and return decoders at the chosen worker. In each branch invert its own normalized legal 75%/25% mixed T1 action CDF, with four immutable return terms in the return decoder; all other slots greedily re-decode against actual prefix. Apply actual full return guard, aggregate masses AND derivatives for identical complete physical orders. At every other controlled step use the actual frozen greedy parent. No paid search or native opponent calls. All completed simulated continuations are scored by the official terminal utility.
sampling: Eight iid uniforms per root with replacement from SeedSequence([994371,map,seat,t]); deterministic control/continuation and same opponent history for all choices. Identical complete joint actions can reuse byte-identical deterministic continuation. Save all draws and raw suffixes, count independent maps and roots separately. Keep all signs and unchanged joints.
comparison: No-update control on the same root is the frozen real greedy deployed parent. On two separate fresh development maps score publicly packaged updated and frozen greedy actors over full legal games against the same own low-cost opponent per map ('economy' for first, 'raid' for second), both seats. Preserve action tapes and independent official replay; additionally report paired score and utility and direct policy disagreement on common public roots. No final maps or Master3s2 matches.
training_opponents: Alternate economy and raid by registered training map index; reset or restore opponent state from actual public history, never showing the hidden board.
optimization: One normalized policy-gradient step affecting exactly the five FP32 deployable Sapling whead.bias coordinates, maximum L2 0.5, up to six deterministic halvings. Leave-one-draw-out same-root baseline, equal weight per map and then per root, all executed joint-command probabilities. Accept only if no old positive support disappears, maximum per-root KL(old||new)<=0.02 and actually recomputed PPO clipped relative surrogate gain>1e-10, epsilon=.2. Otherwise retain zero. Never use the independent games to tune.
budget: CPU 3 nice19 one thread. At most 64 sampled endpoint labels on 8 roots plus 8 deterministic parent contrasts (deduplicated within each root); at most 8 full inexpensive held games. No GPU and zero original-examiner games. Training is contextual on-policy control from archived states, not on-policy generation of those opening states.
